{"people":[{"name":"Maya","role":"Head of digital; ran the evaluation","side":"customer"},{"name":"Greg","role":"Controller; signed the contract","side":"customer"},{"name":"Tobi","role":"Solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Speaker 2","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Speaker 1","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Global Payments"],
"incumbent":"Global Payments, through the studio software; still processes at the front desk",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"They report member churn to the board every quarter, it had ticked up two quarters running","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Board-visible churn trend started the evaluation."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"somebody finally split it into people who cancelled and people whose card just failed","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Churn analysis split out involuntary churn from failed cards."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The second bucket was a lot bigger than anyone expected.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Failed-card churn surprised the customer."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"members who never meant to leave","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own framing of involuntary churn."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"I want to say a third of the churn? Don't quote me.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Hedged estimate of the bucket size; number unverified."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"It was in her board deck.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Real number exists in Maya's board deck and could be verified."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Maya. She ran the evaluation, she was in every meeting","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep first names Maya as the decider."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"She said it was her call.","label":"fact","speaker":"Maya (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Maya's claim of ownership, reported rather than quoted verbatim."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Global Payments was already in there, through the studio software.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Identifies the incumbent and how it is embedded."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"they came back with a rate review and a new terminal bundle for the front desks, on a longer contract","label":"fact","speaker":"Maya (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent's counter-offer as reported by the customer."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"I didn't see any of it. That's her telling me.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor details are secondhand only."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"My read is they were rattled, but that's my read, not hers.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's guess about the competitor's state."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Suddenly everything was hardware. Before that meeting it was all failed payments and retries.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Customer's questions shifted after the competitor meeting."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"what readers do you have, do they work inside our studio software, what's the contract term, what does it cost to get out","label":"fact","speaker":"customer (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","gaps","language"],"note":"Customer's new questions on hardware, integration and exit cost."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Greg asked about termination fees twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decider"],"note":"Controller focused on cost of leaving the incumbent."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"The controller.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Greg's role."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"The reaction was failed payment recovery.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of which message landed."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"Tobi, took an export of one month of their failed renewals and showed which ones were the kind that usually come back with a retry or an updated card","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Analysis built on the customer's own data drove the reaction."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"Their file, not our average.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Customer-specific proof beat generic benchmarks."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"Greg hadn't said a word in two meetings, and he asked for the spreadsheet.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider","decided"],"note":"Observed change in behavior from the silent financial signer."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence. I opened with the global slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Global positioning got no reaction."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"They have studios in the US and a handful in Canada.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Customer's footprint doesn't fit a global pitch."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"is that the readers?","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer didn't understand 'unified commerce' and mapped it to hardware."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"Before that I honestly thought we were there to keep the incumbent honest.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","competitor"],"note":"Rep believed we were the column fodder until the data session."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"The paper had gone to Greg and it sat with him for two weeks. Nothing.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"Contract stalled with the controller."},
{"id":"E26","turn":16,"excerpt":"Then we did the data session, and four days later it was signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The data session unlocked the signature."},
{"id":"E27","turn":18,"excerpt":"His signature's on it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Greg signed, which contradicts Maya as sole decider."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"Maya chose us. Greg decided whether anybody got chosen.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep revises the decider account under questioning."},
{"id":"E29","turn":22,"excerpt":"They asked to see our reader working inside their studio management software.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Key ask was front-desk integration."},
{"id":"E30","turn":22,"excerpt":"Check a member in, sell a water bottle, same screen.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Concrete front-desk use case."},
{"id":"E31","turn":22,"excerpt":"We couldn't show that live. It runs through a partner integration, and the partner did a call the week after.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Product gap: no live integrated demo, and the partner was delayed."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"It nearly cost us.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Rep judges the gap nearly lost the deal."},
{"id":"E33","turn":22,"excerpt":"Maya said if front-desk staff have to use two screens","label":"fact","speaker":"Maya (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Condition attached to Maya's warning."},
{"id":"E34","turn":22,"excerpt":"the studio managers will revolt.","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Strong customer language on the two-screen risk."},
{"id":"E35","turn":24,"excerpt":"They saw the partner's demo. Not in their own setup.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Integration still unproven in the customer's environment."},
{"id":"E36","turn":24,"excerpt":"what they signed is memberships. Online billing went first. The studios are phase two.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Only part of the business moved."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"Still Global.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","competitor"],"note":"Incumbent keeps front-desk processing."},
{"id":"E38","turn":28,"excerpt":"Not yet. It depends on the partner piece.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"No date for phase two; it hinges on the gap."},
{"id":"E39","turn":30,"excerpt":"Can we do that one over Slack?","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Language question deferred and never answered."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8","E25","E27","E28"],"what":"Rep first names Maya as the decider, then admits the contract sat with Greg, he signed it, and he decided whether anyone got chosen."},
{"evidence":["E26","E36","E37","E38"],"what":"The deal is framed as won and signed, but only memberships and online billing moved. Studios and the front desk remain with Global, with no phase-two date."},
{"evidence":["E17","E13","E14"],"what":"Rep says failed payment recovery got the reaction, but after the competitor meeting the customer's questions shifted almost entirely to hardware and exit costs."},
{"evidence":["E21","E22"],"what":"Pitch opened with global positioning for a customer that operates only in the US and a handful of Canadian studios."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"How big was that bucket?","turn":4,"what":"Rep gave a hedged estimate ('Don't quote me') even though the real figure is in Maya's board deck."},
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":6,"what":"Rep named Maya alone; only after pressing (T17-T20) did he concede Greg held the signature and the real go/no-go."},
{"question":"When did you first feel this was won?","turn":16,"what":"Rep described the win moment without mentioning it was a partial win; the scope limit surfaced only later at T24."},
{"question":"What exact words did they—","turn":30,"what":"Rep deferred the language question to Slack for a call; it was never answered."}
],
"skipped":["language"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"members who never meant to leave","ours":"failed payment recovery","evidence":["E4","E17"]},
{"theirs":"is that the readers?","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E23"]},
{"theirs":"two screens / the studio managers will revolt / same screen","ours":"partner integration","evidence":["E30","E31","E33","E34"]},
{"theirs":"what does it cost to get out / termination fees","ours":"keep the incumbent honest","evidence":["E14","E15","E24"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E26","E27"],"what":"Contract signed by Greg four days after the data session."},
{"evidence":["E36"],"what":"Partial win: only memberships and online billing moved; studios are phase two."},
{"evidence":["E37","E38"],"what":"Global Payments still processes at the front desk; phase two has no date and depends on the partner integration."},
{"evidence":["E31","E32","E35"],"what":"Front-desk integration gap was never proven in the customer's setup and nearly lost the deal."},
{"evidence":["E10"],"what":"Incumbent countered with a rate review, a terminal bundle and a longer contract, which may hold the studios."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep first names Maya as the decider, then admits the contract sat with Greg, he signed it, and he decided whether anyone got chosen.
The deal is framed as won and signed, but only memberships and online billing moved. Studios and the front desk remain with Global, with no phase-two date.
Rep says failed payment recovery got the reaction, but after the competitor meeting the customer's questions shifted almost entirely to hardware and exit costs.
Pitch opened with global positioning for a customer that operates only in the US and a handful of Canadian studios.

outcome_signals.what: Contract signed by Greg four days after the data session.
Partial win: only memberships and online billing moved; studios are phase two.
Global Payments still processes at the front desk; phase two has no date and depends on the partner integration.
Front-desk integration gap was never proven in the customer's setup and nearly lost the deal.
Incumbent countered with a rate review, a terminal bundle and a longer contract, which may hold the studios.
